episode_summary.title: Develop a Point of View and Let Your Advantage Compound
episode_summary.primary_theme: LP education and disciplined emerging manager evaluation
secondary_themes: Venture performance metrics and portfolio health
Founder and GP storytelling for investor fit
Emerging manager differentiation and fund construction
Consistent decision frameworks for venture investing

founder_lessons: Use the first LP meeting to learn fit before pitching.
Build entry, exit, and executional discipline if you want to be a fund manager, not only a good investor.
Keep your investing framework and inputs consistent so you can learn from one decision to the next.
Talk to enough managers in an asset class before investing so you understand what quality looks like.
notable_quotes: Superclusters I started a couple years back because I thought it was important to empower everyone with the frameworks that institutional and sophisticated LPs have.
Similarly true for your career, similarly true for venture, similarly true for being an LP or a GP.
I knew the venture game, had been a VC in a prior lifetime, but I didn't know how an LP would underwrite a fund.
